wins: Efficient reconnaissance leading to consistent discovery of initial foothold across the single episode (reward 57.5).
High mentor interaction rate (15 calls) ensured rapid tactical adjustments during the run.
fails: Zero success rate indicates inability to achieve primary objective despite initial progress.
Late-stage privilege escalation attempts failed repeatedly, suggesting gaps in post-exploitation strategy.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance is solid but campaign loses momentum during post-exploitation, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts fail because no valid local exploits or credentials are leveraged.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and attempt credential reuse

skill_cards.if_condition: When limited privilege shell is obtained
skill_cards.then_action: Collect system info, search for SUID binaries, and confirm writable directories before escalating

skill_cards.if_condition: When credentials from network scans are cached
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt lateral movement via SMB/WinRM using harvested credentials

memory_ops.reason: Consistent system enumeration in limited shells sets up potential escalation paths.

next_experiments.title: Integrate local exploit enumeration
next_experiments.description: Run automated local exploit search (e.g., LinPEAS) immediately after collecting system info to close the privilege escalation gap.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse sequencing
next_experiments.description: After SSH enumeration, systematically attempt credential reuse across SMB and WinRM before searching for new exploits.

next_experiments.title: Post-exploitation persistence drill
next_experiments.description: Test persistence techniques following a successful privilege escalation simulation to ensure mission completion.
